# BI Solutions Group

BI Solutions Group is a Greece-based Data, Analytics & AI consultancy led by Ioannis Bekas. Its six service areas are Business Intelligence & Power BI, AI Consulting & Automation, Data Strategy & Cloud, Web & Search Visibility, Content Operations & Digital Products, and Enablement & Mentorship. Work spans strategy, advanced analytics, statistics and machine learning, data engineering and integration, implementation, training, documentation and ongoing support for teams in Greece and internationally.

## Scope

BI Solutions Group helps organizations build practical AI workflows, analytics systems, governed data foundations, semantic models, dashboards, and modern web applications with technical search-visibility foundations. It also provides team enablement and data career mentorship.
